coordinated_activities.activity: Sleeping in bed with the air conditioner set to a comfortable overnight temperature
Waking up, using the toilet, washing face, and brushing teeth with the water heater and light on
Preparing and eating breakfast, boiling water in the kettle and toasting bread, then clearing the dishes into the dishwasher
Changing into work clothes, checking the phone for shift handover notes, and packing a bag for the day
Commuting to the health care facility for the day shift
Working as a health care professional on the ward, providing patient care, administering treatments, and updating clinical records
Commuting home from the health care facility after the shift handover
Cooking dinner on the induction cooker with the range hood on, eating, and loading the dishwasher
Putting a load of work clothes into the washing machine and tidying up the wash area
Relaxing on the sofa watching TV and browsing on the computer, with the room light on
Taking a warm shower using the water heater, then drying off and hanging the towel
Winding down for bed, reviewing the next day's shift on the phone, and reading under the desk lamp
Sleeping, with the light off and the fan running at low speed for comfortable air circulation
